claims: Amy Madigan won the Best Supporting Actress Oscar at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.
Amy Madigan won the Best Supporting Actress Oscar for her role as Aunt Gladys in the horror film Weapons.
Amy Madigan's win marked her first Oscar win.
Amy Madigan's Oscar win came 40 years after her last nomination.
Amy Madigan is the second-oldest winner in the Best Supporting Actress category.
Amy Madigan's win is the first acting win for a horror film since 2011.
